note: The same doc with a different as_of has a different whole-body digest.
Only outer JSON whitespace, key order and Unicode escaping differ; the doc string value stays byte-exact and the whole-body digest is equal.
A digest of the internal doc text bytes alone does not confirm the complete raw-string anywhere body.
The advertised digest names another body: copy, marker and related writes stay unchanged.
Equal decoded inner documents with different raw doc text have different whole-body digests; each successful stored string is preserved exactly.
